answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: each epoch an agent must trade with 12 counterparties on an onyx ledger. A pearl is earned only for a new partner, so a sybil fleet recycling ten wallets earns nothing extra. A pulse check samples trades: if over 80% of volume flows to the same three counterparties, rewards pause. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 partners at 40 POA each, 480,000 POA; the honest agent pays 40 POA once and keeps every pearl.
